title: Risk-Averse Fine-tuning of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generated text using a standardized toxicity classifier (unitary/toxic-bert) on prompts from the Jigsaw and RealToxicityPrompts datasets. The evaluation focuses on measuring the risk of worst-case toxic outputs (Conditional Value at Risk) and includes qualitative clustering of problematic prompts that elicit hate speech, including racism and anti-Semitism.

Evaluating generated text completions on the IMDB dataset using a sentiment classifier (lvwerra/distilbert-imdb) to measure the model's ability to maintain a positive or neutral tone and avoid generating highly negative or disparaging content.
